_comment: The run's standing objects, filed by how they are spent — the deciding rule from design/spire-ai/ui/ENTITY_STANDARDS.md. Relic: costs nothing, applies always. Power: costs nothing, fires on an event. Potion: consumed once. Curse: costs you every turn and you did not want it. Lifted out of demo.js, which held them inline.

relics.name: Ruff Strict
relics.rule: Lint and format with Ruff. Resolve every warning before committing.

relics.name: Typed Public API
relics.rule: Type-hint public functions and keep the type checker clean.

relics.name: No Mocks In Prod
relics.rule: Never ship mock, stub, or placeholder data in production paths.

relics.name: Stdlib Only
relics.rule: Engine scripts import the standard library and nothing else.

relics.name: Coverage Floor
relics.rule: Never drop coverage silently. A regression needs a written reason.

relics.name: Small Diffs
relics.rule: One reviewable unit per room. If it needs two summaries, it is two diffs.

relics.name: Vendored Fork
relics.rule: You own the vendored code. Patches land here, not upstream.

relics.name: Singing Bowl
relics.rule: Skipping a card reward pays 2 focus instead of nothing.

powers.name: ruff-on-edit
powers.note: Lints touched Python after an edit.

powers.name: reward-gate
powers.note: Decides whether a room was cleared.

powers.name: ascension-gate
powers.note: Blocks Stop when the tier's gates fail. Only present at A5+.

potions.name: Bisect
potions.spent_on: Find the commit that broke it.

potions.name: Profiler Run
potions.spent_on: Name one bottleneck with a number attached.

potions.name: Timeboxed Spike
potions.spent_on: Answer one design question and stop.

potions.name: Flame Graph
potions.spent_on: See where the time actually goes.

potions.name: Blame Walk
potions.spent_on: Find who knew why, and when.

curses.name: Bloated Scope
curses.cost: Every feature room costs 1 extra energy.

curses.name: Deprecated Client
curses.cost: Infra rooms may reopen after clearing.

curses.name: Unreviewed Rewrite
curses.cost: Refactor rooms need one extra progress to clear.
curses.why: Merged a three-week branch nobody read.

curses.name: The Unasked Question
curses.why: Built the dashboard without asking what it decides.

curses.name: Deleted Unknowns
curses.cost: Bug rooms need one extra progress to clear.

curses.name: Symptom Patch
curses.cost: The next bug room this act is an elite.

curses.name: Hesitation
curses.cost: The first card played in a room costs 1 extra energy.

badges._comment: Slay the Spire 2 ships Badges at the end of a run — 'little reminders to let you know what was unique about each run'. Ported, and pointed at the property sts-fidelity.md says most needs a visible payout: refusal. Each badge is a pure function of the save, evaluated when an act is cleared, so nothing here can be granted for free.

definitions.name: Ascetic
definitions.blurb: Skipped {skipped} rewards. Discipline that shows up as a number.

definitions.name: Lean Deck
definitions.blurb: Finished the act on {cards} cards. The cap was never close.

definitions.name: Elite Hunter
definitions.blurb: Took {elites} elites when the map offered a way around.

definitions.name: Cartographer
definitions.blurb: Marked {annotations} nodes before committing to a route.

definitions.name: Clean Hands
definitions.blurb: Cleared the act carrying no curses.

definitions.name: Ascended
definitions.blurb: Climbed at A{ascension}, which grants nothing and never has.
